rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The /uniFB01 nal neuroimaging data set consisted of 1,062 participants 10 -25 years old (typically developing control subjects, N=622; individuals with psychosis spectrum disorders, N=194; individuals with other psychopathology, N=246) from four different samples.
